pages.title: Spooky Halloween Makeover
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Pick from 15 Halloween makeover styles in Spooky Halloween Makeover. Put together a look for the character, then decorate a room to go with it. Change the room’s details until the setting suits the spooky style you’ve chosen.

pages.title: Halloween Match
pages.creator: Pro Mobile
pages.description: Tap creatures to send them floating upward in Halloween Match. When two identical ones meet, they merge and disappear. Look for pairs among the spooky characters and choose what to release next as you build your Halloween collection.

pages.title: Push.io
pages.creator: Mao Games
pages.description: Knock rivals into the water with a boomerang in Push.io. Move around the arena to avoid incoming throws and stay on the map as long as you can. Use trophies and boomerang upgrades between rounds to work your way up the standings.

pages.title: Max Speed
pages.creator: SMOKOKO LTD
pages.description: Take sports cars onto 3D courses in Max Speed. Race through different locations, launch off jumps, and keep control as you come back down. Upgrade and customize your cars before taking them out for more races and stunts.

pages.title: Dinosaurs vs Asteroids
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Arm dinosaurs to stop falling asteroids in Dinosaurs vs Asteroids. Fit weapons such as miniguns or flamethrowers to their mounts and use them to break up the rocks. Try species that can shoot spikes or smash asteroids with their claws for a different approach.

pages.title: Association - Connect Word
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Group related words in Association - Connect Word. Read through the terms and look for a theme that links several of them. Take your time as the connections get less obvious, or use a hint when you can’t find where a word belongs.

pages.title: Block Breaker
pages.creator: Done23
pages.description: Break ice blocks to send a character toward the goal in Block Breaker. Work out which blocks to remove, then use springs and portals to change where the character goes. Think about how each move affects the next bounce before launching toward the platform.

pages.title: Ultra Realistic BlockCraft
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Help Steve reach the portal in Ultra Realistic BlockCraft. Collect every diamond, open chests along the route, and get past the monsters before heading for the exit. You only have one life, so watch for danger while gathering what you need.

pages.title: Worms
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Guide a worm through winding mazes in Worms. Collect rewards and use portals to reach other parts of the layout. Look ahead before turning down a passage so you can keep moving without getting stuck in a dead end.

pages.title: Guess The Italian Brainrot Animals
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Identify Italian Brainrot characters from three emojis in Guess The Italian Brainrot Animals. Look for what the symbols have in common and pick the character before time runs out. Work through clues for 64 characters, from familiar faces to less obvious ones.

pages.title: Super Racing
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Race across four connected courses in Super Racing. Travel between mountains, forests, cities, and other settings as the weather and time of day change. Collect coins to unlock cars and characters, and try to earn the most points across the linked routes.

pages.title: Supermarket Sort: Grocery Game
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Sort groceries before the timer runs out in Supermarket Sort: Grocery Game. Check where the items are and look for groups you can put together quickly. Later levels give you trickier arrangements, so plan what to move first while you watch the clock.

pages.title: Stickman Troll Thief Puzzle
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Help a stickman reach his target in Stickman Troll Thief Puzzle. Work out how to get to the object without running into a trap or alerting someone in the way. Look over the whole scene before making a move, because the direct path can lead straight into trouble.

pages.title: LampHead
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Escape a dark passage in LampHead by switching between two planes. Watch for sharp obstacles and move to the other side when your route is blocked. Collect bonuses as you go and keep watching what’s ahead so you can switch again in time.

pages.title: Royal Bubble Blast
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Aim colored bubbles into matching groups in Royal Bubble Blast. Look for a shot that opens room for the next one, then check the remaining bubbles before you fire again. Keep playing to see how high you can score in the castle-themed layout.

pages.title: Over the Rainbow
pages.creator: Disintegrator, LLC.
pages.description: Help Alex the Elf bring the colors back in Over the Rainbow. Time your jumps to move through the level while keeping clear of enemies. Look for power-ups as you go and use them to help Alex reach the next part of the rainbow.

pages.title: Crowd Clash Rush
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Lead a warrior into battle in Crowd Clash Rush. Keep moving through the 3D course and watch where groups of enemies are approaching. Look for a route into the next fight that gives you room to react when the crowd closes in.

pages.title: Spacebar Clicker
pages.creator: Zhivotech
pages.description: Click or press the spacebar to gather light years in Spacebar Clicker. Recruit aliens to help you collect more, then use the rewards you unlock to speed up the trip. Build up enough light years to work toward the jump to another galaxy.

pages.title: Only Up Parkour 2
pages.creator: NISHAD_Games
pages.description: Climb a vertical obstacle course in Only Up Parkour 2. Line up each jump before you leave a platform and watch for obstacles that can send you back down. Work your way through increasingly difficult sections as you aim for the 500-meter mark.

pages.title: Fruits Match
pages.creator: sublevelgames
pages.description: Collect matching sets of three fruit tiles in Fruits Match. Use the available slots carefully as you work toward clearing the stage. If a move leaves you stuck, you can use an extra slot, shuffle the board, or undo a move.

pages.title: Number Jelly POP
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Drop numbered jellies in Number Jelly POP and merge ones with the same value. Keep the pile clear of the sensor by choosing where each jelly lands. Use a bomb jelly to clear part of the board when you need more room to keep merging.

pages.title: Ship containers
pages.creator: mzworks
pages.description: Load shipping containers onto a ship in Ship containers. Tap to drop each one and choose the moment so it lands where it can stay balanced. Keep loading without losing containers over the side and try to beat your previous score.

pages.title: My Craft: Craft Adventure
pages.creator: Bin Studio
pages.description: Help a craft boy find his way out of a forest maze in My Craft: Craft Adventure. Follow the route through obstacles and watch for monsters blocking the way. Keep exploring until you find a path that brings him out of the forest.

pages.title: Freddy's runner
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Run from Huggy Wuggy in Freddy's runner. Use WASD or the arrow keys to get around obstacles and pick up the lost bills along the route. Keep ahead of the chase and head for the hiding place once you’ve collected them.

pages.title: CrateMage
pages.creator: Digital Oddities
pages.description: Link crates with magical orbs in CrateMage so they move together. Look at where each linked crate will go before you make a move, then use their shared movement to solve the room. Work deeper into the dungeon to find the treasure.

pages.title: Squid Stacky Maze
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Gather stacks and find a route off the island in Squid Stacky Maze. Choose your path so you pick up the pieces you need, then use the stack to get past the obstacles. Work through 30 layouts as you make your escape.

pages.title: Long Neck Run
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Run through gates and collect rings that match your current color in Long Neck Run. The more matching rings you grab, the taller your character gets. Reach the finish platform and see how your height compares with the buildings and objects you unlock.

pages.title: Birthday Girl Jigsaw
pages.creator: Baby Daisy Games
pages.description: Reassemble six birthday pictures in Birthday Girl Jigsaw. Pick a puzzle mode, then drag the pieces together using colors and outlines as clues. Try another picture or switch modes when you want to solve a different layout.

pages.title: Awesome Seaquest
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: Build up a navy in Awesome Seaquest and take territory back from the red army. Add ships as your fleet grows and research special weapons to prepare for tougher fights. Decide where to invest before sending your forces back into battle.

pages.title: Bonnie and BFFs Valentine Day Party
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Get Bonnie and her friends ready for a Valentine’s Day party in Bonnie and BFFs Valentine Day Party. Choose outfits with hearts or floral details, try pink, red, or gold makeup, and finish each look with a hairstyle and accessories.

pages.title: Hit Masters Rush
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Chase enemies across rooftops in Hit Masters Rush. Jump gaps, slide under obstacles, and shoot the enemies ahead while the hero keeps moving. Watch the next rooftop so you know when to move and when you have a clear shot.

pages.title: Shoe Race
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Pick the right shoes for the surface in Shoe Race. Watch for a change in the course and switch footwear to suit what comes next. Make the choice quickly to keep your racer moving through each stretch.

pages.title: Go To Dot
pages.creator: Ramblo Digital Media
pages.description: Jump toward the center of a circular maze in Go To Dot. Watch the bombs moving around the rings and choose when to cross each gap. Collect jewels as you go and use them to change how your ball looks.

pages.title: Soccer Heroes
pages.creator: Polar Games
pages.description: Pick a team and handle both attack and defense in Soccer Heroes. Use swipes to move and send the ball toward goal, then get back into position when the other side takes over. Look for a chance to score before the opponent closes the gap.

pages.title: Puppy Sling
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Drag and release to sling a puppy upward in Puppy Sling. Aim from one point to the next and use bounces to keep climbing. Pick up coins along the way to unlock breeds such as corgis, pugs, and Shiba Inus.

pages.title: Jeep Driver
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drive a jeep through 30 levels in Jeep Driver. Keep the vehicle under control as you work through each course, then visit the garage to buy another vehicle or improve the one you have. Take your upgrades back out on the next drive.

pages.title: Merge the Gems
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Combine gems with equal values in Merge the Gems and work toward a gem numbered 30. Look for merges that create combos and keep the pile low. The run ends if the gems reach the ceiling, so check where the next match will leave you before moving.

pages.title: Bubble Invasion
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Clear groups of matching bubbles in Bubble Invasion to protect your base. Pick a shot that brings together at least two bubbles of the same color. Keep an eye on the line as the bubbles approach, and look for another group before they cross it.

pages.title: Moon Clash Heroes
pages.creator: Freeway Interactive
pages.description: Join a space squad and fight through an abandoned lunar base in Moon Clash Heroes. Choose between roles such as a spy, a soldier with a lightning gun, or a strike bot with a photon weapon. Use the base’s passages to find a position that suits your weapon.

pages.title: Knockem All
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Run along an endless track and shoot blocks out of your way in Knockem All. Black blocks resist your shots, so watch for them while clearing other obstacles. Use help when it’s available and visit the shop for a different outfit between runs.

pages.title: 2 Colors Box
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Switch a box between black and white in 2 Colors Box. Click or tap to change its color, then line it up with the next incoming box. Make sure the colors match at contact so you can collect the box and move on to the next one.

pages.title: Cat Belly Rub
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Rub a kitten’s belly in Cat Belly Rub until the progress bar fills. Finish a round to open the next level, then keep playing with the kitten as you go. Feed it along the way and look for diamonds you can collect.

pages.title: Angry Goat Wild Animal Rampage Game 2020
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Cause as much damage as you can in Angry Goat Wild Animal Rampage Game 2020. Steer a goat through the area and look for things you can knock over or break. Move on to another part of the map when you want more targets to wreck.

pages.title: Smoothie
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Make a drink in Smoothie by choosing ingredients and adding them to the blender. Mix them to see what color the finished drink turns out, then try another combination. Work through the steps and make another cup when you want to experiment with different ingredients.

pages.title: Highway Drive 2D
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Choose a car and head onto the highway in Highway Drive 2D. Watch the traffic ahead and steer into clear gaps as you drive. Keep the run going as long as you can and try to beat your previous score on another attempt.

pages.title: Crossy Word
pages.creator: Gamearcade.org
pages.description: Answer clues to fill a crossword in Crossy Word. Tap a row or column to see its question, then use the answer to complete that part of the grid. Use letters you’ve already placed to solve crossing words, or ask for a hint if a clue has you stuck.

pages.title: Doodle Dunk
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Draw a route for the ball in Doodle Dunk. Curve your line around obstacles and walls, and only make contact with players wearing the same outfit as you. Pick up coins along your route to buy new outfits or balls, then see if you can reach the hoop.

pages.title: Shooting Zombie fps Xtreme Good vs Bad Boys
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Fight soldiers and zombies in Shooting Zombie fps Xtreme Good vs Bad Boys. Work through 40 offline levels or play with friends in multiplayer. Choose from modes such as Survival, Gun Game, and Team Deathmatch when you want a different kind of fight.

pages.title: Defense Battle
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Build a defense to protect the left side of the field in Defense Battle. Put together a battalion to stop skull soldiers across nine levels. Watch for the Stone Monster as the attacks get tougher, because letting it through can cost you the base.

pages.title: Short Life 2
pages.creator: gametornado
pages.description: Guide a ragdoll through dangerous platforming levels in Short Life 2. Watch the traps before moving and time your steps and jumps to get around them. Try to reach each exit with the character intact, even when the safest route takes longer.

pages.title: Particle
pages.creator: Maxence Perion
pages.description: Explore with a small field of view in Particle. Look for flames as the area around you comes into view, and see how far you can travel while collecting them. Use the flames you’ve gathered to buy upgrades before trying another run.

pages.title: Sweet Kitty Spot the Differences
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Compare two cat pictures in Sweet Kitty Spot the Differences. Look at the shapes, colors, and objects in both scenes and select the details that changed. Check the edges as well as the main subject if you’re having trouble finding the remaining differences.

pages.title: FZ Snow Battle IO
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Make snowballs and knock rivals off the field in FZ Snow Battle IO. Build one big snowball to ram into an opponent, or make smaller ones you can aim at a distance. Watch your position as other players try to push you out too.

pages.title: Asian Offroad Cargo Truck Driver Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Haul goods along narrow mountain roads in Asian Offroad Cargo Truck Driver Game. Keep the long truck lined up around bends and adjust your speed on uneven climbs. Work your way through the route carefully so you can complete the transport job.

pages.title: Cannon Duck
pages.creator: Reinarte Games
pages.description: Launch a duck from cannon to cannon in Cannon Duck. Watch where the next cannon is and wait for the right moment to fire. Keep the transfers going and try to make it farther than you did on your last run.

pages.title: Azure Sea Fishing
pages.creator: Playcombo
pages.description: Head out to catch saltwater fish in Azure Sea Fishing. Look for species such as barracuda, dorado, and sharks as you fish the open water. Try for another catch once you’ve landed one and see what turns up on the next cast.

pages.title: Cool Snakes
pages.creator: GameOnHai
pages.description: Grow a snake in the snowy arena of Cool Snakes. Steer through the 3D space and collect power-ups to help you grow faster. Watch where the other snakes are moving as you look for ways to get longer and climb ahead of them.

pages.title: Space Rush
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Pilot a spacecraft through courses in Space Rush. Use the mouse or the A and D keys to steer, and watch the gaps ahead as the ship picks up speed. Keep clear of the walls and work toward opening another level.

pages.title: Funny Cars For Kids Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Choose one of eight car illustrations in Funny Cars For Kids Coloring. Fill in the picture using 23 available colors, and work quickly if you’re aiming for a higher score. Save the finished picture when you’ve found a color combination you like.

pages.title: Shooting Stars
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Take aim at the stars in Shooting Stars. Use the mouse to set up a shot and watch how it travels after each bounce. Check which stars you still need to hit and adjust your aim as you work through the game’s 20 levels.

pages.title: Ferrari 812 GTS Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reassemble six pictures of the Ferrari 812 GTS in Ferrari 812 GTS Puzzle. Set the piece count to 16, 36, 64, or 100, then look for joins along the bodywork and background. Try a larger layout when you want a harder version of the same picture.

pages.title: Halloween Memory
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Flip cards to find matching Halloween pictures in Halloween Memory. Remember which cards you’ve already seen so you can go back to one when you uncover its partner. Clear all the pairs before the timer runs out.

pages.title: Scary Boy Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Color a spooky character in Scary Boy Coloring Book. Choose shades for his clothes and other details, then see how your choices change the Halloween look. Try a different set of colors if you want to give the picture another style.

pages.title: Kids Maths Fun
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Work through math questions in Kids Maths Fun. Read each problem, choose the answer you think is right, and keep an eye on the timer as the next one comes up. Try to build your score by answering accurately before the clock runs down.

pages.title: Cute Dogs Jigsaw
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Choose one of 12 dog pictures in Cute Dogs Jigsaw. Set the difficulty to 25, 49, or 100 pieces, then look for matching fur colors and edges as you assemble the image. Pick another dog or try the same one with more pieces.

pages.title: Fishing Mania
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Time your cast in Fishing Mania so the swinging hook reaches a fish. Watch what’s swimming within reach and aim for higher-value catches when you can. Keep fishing until your score meets the level’s goal, then see what new catches become available.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle On The Beach
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Piece together 16 seaside photographs in Jigsaw Puzzle On The Beach. Look for the horizon, shoreline, or other details that continue from one piece to the next. Finish one image and pick another beach scene when you want a new puzzle.

pages.title: Prints From Head To Toe
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Build a head-to-toe printed outfit in Prints From Head To Toe. Look through the patterned clothes and try pieces together to see which prints suit the style you want. Give each fashionista a different combination of colors and patterns.

pages.title: Helicopter Jigsaw
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Drag pieces into place in Helicopter Jigsaw. There are ten pictures, and you’ll need to earn in-game money to buy more of them. Choose from three difficulty settings and try a harder layout to earn more toward your next helicopter picture.

pages.title: Break the Key
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Move a block up, down, left, or right in Break the Key. Look at how the block can reach the key and plan a route across the board before moving. Use the available directions to bring the block into contact with the key and clear the puzzle.

pages.title: Skull Hunter
pages.creator: jetlabgames
pages.description: Click or tap to rise in Skull Hunter. Watch the enemies and walls ahead and decide whether to avoid an enemy or use it to get past the next obstacle. Time your moves to keep going as the next hazards come into view.

pages.title: Micro Racing
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Steer a miniature car with the left and right keys in Micro Racing. Read the next bend before turning and try to keep the car on the course as you race the clock. Repeat the run to see whether a cleaner line improves your time.

pages.title: Croatia Jigsaw Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Put together pictures of Croatia in Croatia Jigsaw Challenge. Pick easy, medium, or hard for each image and look for colors and lines that carry across pieces. There’s no time limit, so you can work through a tricky section at your own pace.

pages.title: Odd One Out
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Find the item that differs from the rest in Odd One Out. Scan the choices for a detail that breaks the pattern and select it before time runs out. Keep working through the changing layouts and see how high you can push your score.

pages.title: Zombie 3D Survival Offline
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Survive an offline zombie attack in Zombie 3D Survival Offline. Face different enemies, including zombie dogs, larger undead, and bosses. Watch what’s coming next and focus your fire on the threats that are hardest to keep away from you.

pages.title: Circle Shooter
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Time your shots in Circle Shooter. Watch the arrow on the round launcher and tap when it points toward a white ball. Check the direction before you fire again and keep landing shots to build your score.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Seychelles
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Explore Seychelles through the pictures in Jigsaw Puzzle Seychelles. Use changes in color and the outlines of the scenery to work out which pieces fit together. Finish the current image to see the full view and try a different scene when you’re ready.

pages.title: Vanellope Coloring Book
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Color Vanellope and Ralph in Vanellope Coloring Book. Choose your own colors for Vanellope’s racing car and work through the character drawings one page at a time. Flip back through the book afterward to see all the pictures you’ve finished.

pages.title: Word Connect
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Connect letters to uncover hidden words in Word Connect. Look for a short word you can make from the available letters, then try rearranging them to find others. Keep looking for new combinations until you’ve found every word in the puzzle.

pages.title: Mothers Day Surprise
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help baby Elsa plan a surprise in Mothers Day Surprise. Dress her and Queen Elsa for the occasion, then make an album of her mother’s memories. Get the gift and dinner ready before it’s time to show her what baby Elsa has planned.

pages.title: Fly or Die
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Fly an aircraft into zombie territory in Fly or Die. Take on the undead as you cross different areas and work toward destroying the mother hive. Upgrade the aircraft between attempts so it can make it farther on the next flight.

pages.title: Cyber Shooting
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Fight your way out of virtual reality in Cyber Shooting. Move with the arrow keys or WASD and launch GLITCH with Space or Enter. Use its power as you move through cyberspace and try to defeat the C.O.R.E. so you can get back.

pages.title: Day of the Cats: Episode 2
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Slide the pictures up and down in Day of the Cats: Episode 2 to find what’s different. Compare matching sections as they come into view and pick out the details that change. Keep scrolling until you’ve searched the whole scene.

pages.title: Princesses College Looks
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Put together outfits for a special school day in Princesses College Looks. Browse the clothes for each princess and decide what suits the occasion. Try different combinations so each character has her own look before heading to college.

pages.title: Celebrity Personal Tailor
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Find the tools you need for a fitting in Celebrity Personal Tailor. Once everything’s ready, choose clothes for your client and try different textures and colors together. Work through the tasks to finish an outfit that fits the look you want.

pages.title: Princesses Prom Night
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Get Ariel, Belle, and Jasmine ready in Princesses Prom Night. Choose a dress for each princess and match it with a hairstyle, shoes, and a purse. Finish with makeup and give each girl a different look for the evening.
